EN: Proper stretching?
Um... Leaving the Vault?
Not getting distracted by over-talkative companions?
ZH: 不要被喋喋不休的同伴所干扰而分心？

EN: When we get back, what are you going to do first?
ZH: 当我们回来的时候，你第一件事是做什么？

EN: Probably take my allocated 2.5 minute shower.
ZH: 也许是去洗一个分配给我的2分半钟的澡。

EN: Maybe talk to my special someone and, you know. Dance.
ZH: 也许和某个特别的人交谈，还有，你懂的，跳舞。

EN: Request never to be assigned with you again.
ZH: 向上级请求再也不要和你分配在一起了。

EN: I am SO not having fun.
Oh, come on. It's not that bad. Okay, it IS. But still.
ZH: 哦，拜托，没那么糟吧。好吧，确实挺糟。但不管怎样。

EN: Speak for yourself. I'm having a blast!
ZH: 那是你，我可是玩得很开心！

EN: You're such a buzzkill.
What are you thinking about?
Huh? Thinking? Am I SUPPOSED to be thinking?
ZH: 哈？想？我应该想点什么吗？

EN: Oh, the usual: the difference between narwhals and unicorns.
ZH: 哦，老样子：独角鲸和独角兽的区别。

EN: I'm thinking I really wish you'd focus on the mission.
ZH: 我在想，你真的应该专心在任务上。

EN: What do you think they're doing back in the Vault?
ZH: 你觉得避难所里的人正在干嘛？

EN: Oh, you know. Having fun. Staying safe. Being happy.
ZH: 哦，你懂的。玩得开心，住得安全，安居乐业。

EN: I try not to think about it. It's too depressing.
ZH: 我试着不要去想那些。太让人沮丧了。

EN: Nothing half as cool as this!
ZH: 比起我们这个差远了吧。

EN: So what do you think of the Wasteland?
Kind of charming, right? In it's own horrible way.
ZH: 挺迷人的，对吧？用它那吓人的独门方式。

EN: It's a complete nightmare. Duh.
ZH: 是一场彻头彻尾的噩梦。这还用说。

EN: Not much to think about. 'Cause... Wasteland.
ZH: 没什么好想的。因为……废土呗。

EN: Ever feel like life is just an illusion?
ZH: 你有没有觉得生活不过是场幻觉？

EN: Yeah! Like we're all just pawns in some game...
ZH: 是的！我们就像是某盘棋里任人摆布的棋子……

EN: Would you please just focus on what we're doing?
ZH: 你能不能专心点，做我们手头的事？

EN: That's... a really dumb thing to say.
Getting a little tired of questing...
Not me! This is awesome!
Don't worry, we'll be home soon!
ZH: 别担心，我们马上就回家了！

EN: And you're out here because...?
That should come in handy!
Just what I've been looking for
Sweet!
Dibs!
Nice!
Yes!
Awesome!
Cool!
Awwww yeah.
Boom shakalaka!
Ooooh... Now what do we have here?
ZH: 哦哦……看看这是什么好东西……

EN: Oh HECK yeah.
And it's not even my birthday...
ZH: 而且今天还不是我的生日……

EN: Not bad, not bad.
It'll do.
Well HELLO...
Finders keepers!
Gimme gimme!
This ought to be useful.
Just what I was looking for.
Shabooya roll call!
I'll just add this to the pile...
The Overseer's going to love this!
ZH: 监督者一定会喜欢这个的！

EN: Well well well...
Nice find!
Two words: Fine booty.
I'll take whatever I can find.
ZH: 能找到的我全都要带走。

EN: Should come in handy.
Since it's just lying here...
ZH: 既然这东西都躺在这了……

EN: Not bad, not bad...
And the Wasteland just keeps on giving...
Can never have too much stuff...
This'll do.
The things you find out here.
ZH: 在外面这地方，什么都能捡到……

EN: Hope nobody minds if I grab this...
ZH: 我拿走这个，希望没有人介意……

EN: Mine now!
Can't let this go to waste...
I totally deserve this.
To the victor go the spoils!
ZH: 胜利者的战利品，归我啦！

EN: I earned this, dang it.
ZH: 这可是我挣来的，就是这么回事。

EN: I'll take whatever I can get.
ZH: 能找到什么就带走什么。

EN: Out here, you make use of EVERYTHING.
ZH: 在这里，什么都可以物尽其用。

EN: I'll consider this... hazard pay.
ZH: 我就当这是……危险津贴了。

EN: We may need more storage rooms!
ZH: 我们也许需要更多的储藏室！

EN: I'll just take this...
Some may call this junk. Me, I call them treasures.
ZH: 有人管这叫破烂，我管这叫宝贝。

EN: Ain't no waste in the Wasteland!
Let's see what we've got here...
ZH: 让我们来看看这儿有什么……

EN: More goodies!
It's all about the loot.
Go on Quest. Find treasure. Repeat.
ZH: 执行任务。找到宝藏。重复一遍。

EN: Jackpot!
What have we here...
Oh baby!
Noice!
Ka-ching!
Gimme gimme gimme!
Definitely on the right track.
Yeah, this is the right way.
On the right path. I can feel it.
ZH: 这是对的路。我能感觉得出来。

EN: Yup. Going the right way.
Getting closer...
Almost there...
Gotta be this way...
Definitely this way.
Headed in the right direction.
This is the way. Totally.
This feels like the right way...
This feels like the right direction...
No need to turn around. This is the right way.
ZH: 没必要掉头，这个就是正确的路。

EN: If we get out of this alive, the Nuka-Cola's on me.
ZH: 如果我们能活着出去，我请你喝核子可乐。

EN: Comforting, isn't it? Knowing we'll die together.
ZH: 挺欣慰的，不是吗？知道我们会一起死去。

EN: We're in this together. Right?
ZH: 我们一定会同舟共济的，对吧？

EN: Why are we out here again?
ZH: 咱们干吗又跑外面来了？

EN: You as completely creeped out as I am?
ZH: 你是不是和我一样被吓坏了？

EN: We having fun yet?!
ZH: 现在你还觉得有意思吗？！

EN: Come on, we can do it! Right?
Good thing we've got each other...
So glad I'm here with my pals!
ZH: 真高兴能和伙伴们一起来这儿！

EN: Come on, gang. Let's make the Overseer proud!
ZH: 加油啊，各位。咱们一定要让监督者为我们骄傲！

EN: Here we go again...
Let's do this.
Once more unto the breach, dear friends!
ZH: 让我们再次踏上征程，我亲爱的朋友！

EN: Let's show these losers what Vault teamwork looks like.
ZH: 让那帮失败者见识见识，什么叫避难所式的团队协作！

EN: Hey, if I die, I want to be buried in my jumpsuit.
ZH: 嘿，如果我死了，我想穿着这身连身衣下葬。

EN: Onward!
Come on. Let's get it done.
I'm glad you have my back. You do have my back... right?
ZH: 很高兴有你掩护我。你确实会掩护我的……对吧？

EN: Strength in numbers, right?
Don't worry, you've got me. And I'm pretty awesome.
ZH: 别担心，还有我呢。我超厉害的。

EN: So when we get back to the Vault... are we still going to hang out?
ZH: 等咱们回到避难所……还能一起玩吗？

EN: By the numbers, people!
Who's the best? We're the best!
Remember, if one of us goes down, the mission goes on!
ZH: 记住，就算我们中有人倒下了，任务仍要继续！

EN: I bet we get some kind of medal for this.
ZH: 我打赌，这事儿准能给咱们混个奖章。

EN: Don't worry. If you die, I'll tell the Overseer you were a total hero.
ZH: 别担心。如果你死了，我一定会告诉监督者你是一个不折不扣的英雄。

EN: Stay alert.
Stay sharp.
Stay frosty.
Which one of us is in charge? I elect me.
ZH: 我们中谁来负责？我投自己一票。

EN: I feel like we're being... watched.
ZH: 我感觉我们一直被人……监视着。

EN: No stopping us now, right?
ZH: 现在没有什么能阻挡我们了，对吗？

EN: All for one and one for all!
The sooner we do this, the sooner we get home to the Vault.
ZH: 我们完成得越快，就能越早回到避难所。

EN: You didn't pack any Cram, did you? Salty, delicious Cram...
ZH: 你没带饱饱牌肉罐头出来吧？那又咸又可口的饱饱牌肉罐头……

EN: Together we stand, divided we fall!
Come on. Move it or lose it.
ZH: 快点。要么动起来，要么被落下！

EN: Did you hear screams? I thought I heard screams?
ZH: 你听到尖叫了吗？我好像听到了尖叫……

EN: You think this place is haunted? I mean... look at it.
ZH: 你觉得这地方闹鬼？我是说……你看看这里。

EN: We just have to keep moving forward.
Come on! No turning back now!
ZH: 加把劲！没有回头路可走了。

EN: Definitely off track.
No... This doesn't feel like the right way.
ZH: 不……感觉不像是正确的路。

EN: So easy to get turned around in here...
This can't be the right way.
Pretty sure this isn't the right way.
ZH: 我很确定这不是对的路。

EN: Nope. This can't be the right way.
Getting off track.
Nope. Not this way.
Hmm. The way doesn't feel right.
Got a feeling this is the wrong way...
This feels like the wrong way...
This feels like the wrong direction...
Might want to turn around. This isn't the right way.
ZH: 也许该掉头了，这不是正确的路。

EN: Is my... nose bleeding?
So... weak...
Feeling kind of dizzy...
I feel nauseous.
I think I'm going to throw up...
My skin's starting to glow!
Aggh! My fingernails are falling off!
ZH: 啊！我的指甲开始脱落了！

EN: I could really use a RadAway!
Is that a hand... growing out of my stomach?!
ZH: 那是一只手……从我肚子上长出来了吗？！

EN: Someone help! I don't want to become a Ghoul!
ZH: 救救我！我不想成为一个尸鬼！

EN: If there is someone out there, they'll sure be listening to me!
ZH: 如果外面有人在，他们一定会收听我的广播！

EN: To all people out in the Wasteland: We are waiting for you!
ZH: 致废土上的所有人：我们在等你们！

EN: I don't think anyone is listening.
Hello? Is anyone out there?
Oh, a corpse! Isn't that pleasant.
ZH: 哦，一具尸体！可真“令人愉快”啊。

EN: Smells like something died in here... Oh.
ZH: 闻起来好像有什么东西死在了这里……哦。

EN: Can somebody please get this corpse out of here?
ZH: 请问有人能把这具尸体弄走吗？

EN: Working next to a dead body. Not great for my productivity...
ZH: 在尸体旁边工作。对生产力可不太妙……

EN: So it is possible to exercise too much...
ZH: 所以说锻炼真的有可能过量……

EN: They're dead! Was it a weapons malfunction?
ZH: 他们死了！这是武器故障吗？

EN: What were they drinking? I'll have a double.
ZH: 他们在喝什么？我要来个双份。

EN: That has GOT to be a health violation.
ZH: 这绝对是一起卫生违规事件。

EN: Well, you know what they say. You can't take it with you.
ZH: 唉，俗话说得好——身外之物，生不带来死不带去。

EN: That's one way to gain all the knowledge in the universe.
ZH: 这也算是获知宇宙间一切知识的一种办法。

EN: Someone lacked endurance, am I right?
